record.bible_text: <FO><FO>Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> O God<WH0430>, why hast thou cast <FI>us<Fi> off<WH02186><WTH8804> for ever<WH05331>? <FI>why<Fi> doth thine anger<WH0639> smoke<WH06225><WTH8799> against the sheep<WH06629> of thy pasture<WH04830>? <RF>Maschil...: or, A Psalm for Asaph to give instruction<Rf>

Remember<WH02142><WTH8798> thy congregation<WH05712>, <FI>which<Fi> thou hast purchased<WH07069><WTH8804> of old<WH06924>; the rod<WH07626> of thine inheritance<WH05159>, <FI>which<Fi> thou hast redeemed<WH01350><WTH8804>; this mount<WH02022> Zion<WH06726>, wherein thou hast dwelt<WH07931><WTH8804>. <RF>rod: or, tribe<Rf>

Lift up<WH07311><WTH8685> thy feet<WH06471> unto the perpetual<WH05331> desolations<WH04876>; <FI>even<Fi> all <FI>that<Fi> the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> hath done wickedly<WH07489><WTH8689> in the sanctuary<WH06944>.
Thine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802> roar<WH07580><WTH8804> in the midst<WH07130> of thy congregations<WH04150>; they set up<WH07760><WTH8804> their ensigns<WH0226> <FI>for<Fi> signs<WH0226>.
<FI> A man<Fi> was famous<WH03045><WTH8735> according as he had lifted up<WH0935><WTH8688><WH04605> axes<WH07134> upon the thick<WH05442> trees<WH06086>.
But now they break down<WH01986><WTH8799> the carved work<WH06603> thereof at once<WH03162> with axes<WH03781> and hammers<WH03597>.

They have cast<WH07971><WTH8765> fire<WH0784> into thy sanctuary<WH04720>, they have defiled<WH02490><WTH8765> <FI>by casting down<Fi> the dwelling place<WH04908> of thy name<WH08034> to the ground<WH0776>. <RF>They have cast...: Heb. They have sent thy sanctuary unto the fire<Rf>

They said<WH0559><WTH8804> in their hearts<WH03820>, Let us destroy<WH03238><WTH8799> them together<WH03162>: they have burned up<WH08313><WTH8804> all the synagogues<WH04150> of God<WH0410> in the land<WH0776>. <RF>destroy: Heb. break<Rf>
We see<WH07200><WTH8804> not our signs<WH0226>: <FI>there is<Fi> no more any prophet<WH05030>: neither <FI>is there<Fi> among us any that knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> how long<WH05704>.
O God<WH0430>, how long shall the adversary<WH06862> reproach<WH02778><WTH8762>? shall the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> blaspheme<WH05006><WTH8762> thy name<WH08034> for ever<WH05331>?
Why withdrawest<WH07725><WTH8686> thou thy hand<WH03027>, even thy right hand<WH03225>? pluck<WH03615><WTH8761> <FI>it<Fi> out of<WH07130> thy bosom<WH02436><WTH8675><WH02436>.<CM>
For God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> my King<WH04428> of old<WH06924>, working<WH06466><WTH8802> salvation<WH03444> in the midst<WH07130> of the earth<WH0776>.

Thou didst divide<WH06565><WTH8782> the sea<WH03220> by thy strength<WH05797>: thou brakest<WH07665><WTH8765> the heads<WH07218> of the dragons<WH08577> in the waters<WH04325>. <RF>divide: Heb. break<Rf> <RF>dragons: or, whales<Rf>

Thou brakest<WH07533><WTH8765> the heads<WH07218> of leviathan<WH03882> in pieces, <FI>and<Fi> gavest<WH05414><WTH8799> him <FI>to be<Fi> meat<WH03978> to the people<WH05971> inhabiting the wilderness<WH06728>.
Thou didst cleave<WH01234><WTH8804> the fountain<WH04599> and the flood<WH05158>: thou driedst up<WH03001><WTH8689> mighty<WH0386> rivers<WH05104>. <RF>mighty...: Heb. rivers of strength<Rf>
The day<WH03117> <FI>is<Fi> thine, the night<WH03915> also <FI>is<Fi> thine: thou hast prepared<WH03559><WTH8689> the light<WH03974> and the sun<WH08121>.
Thou hast set<WH05324><WTH8689> all the borders<WH01367> of the earth<WH0776>: thou hast made<WH03335><WTH8804> summer<WH07019> and winter<WH02779>. <RF>made: Heb. made them<Rf><CM>

Remember<WH02142><WTH8798> this, <FI>that<Fi> the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> hath reproached<WH02778><WTH8765>, O LORD<WH03068>, and <FI>that<Fi> the foolish<WH05036> people<WH05971> have blasphemed<WH05006><WTH8765> thy name<WH08034>.

O deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> not the soul<WH05315> of thy turtledove<WH08449> unto the multitude<WH02416> <FI>of the wicked<Fi> : forget<WH07911><WTH8799> not the congregation<WH02416> of thy poor<WH06041> for ever<WH05331>.
Have respect<WH05027><WTH8685> unto the covenant<WH01285>: for the dark<WH04285> places of the earth<WH0776> are full<WH04390><WTH8804> of the habitations<WH04999> of cruelty<WH02555>.
O let not the oppressed<WH01790> return<WH07725><WTH8799> ashamed<WH03637><WTH8737>: let the poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034> praise<WH01984><WTH8762> thy name<WH08034>.
Arise<WH06965><WTH8798>, O God<WH0430>, plead<WH07378><WTH8798> thine own cause<WH07379>: remember<WH02142><WTH8798> how the foolish man<WH05036> reproacheth<WH02781> thee daily<WH03117>.

Forget<WH07911><WTH8799> not the voice<WH06963> of thine enemies<WH06887><WTH8802>: the tumult<WH07588> of those that rise up<WH06965><WTH8801> against thee increaseth<WH05927><WTH8802> continually<WH08548>. <RF>increaseth: Heb. ascendeth<Rf><CM>
